line: A game on real Atlanta, where becoming something else changes what the ground is.
bar: On a phone, within 30 seconds: move through recognisable real geography, draw something that becomes shared infrastructure, watch another traveller affected differently by that same mark, BECOME something else, and see the unmoving map reorganise into a different playable board while every prior journey persists as a ghost road.

rounds.title: The spine
rounds.what: Real metro-Atlanta geometry already in this repo, compiled once into a routable graph: real crossings become junctions, real road-over-water crossings become culverts, height is the rank of distance from the real watercourses. Four beings read that one ground through nothing but a cost function — ladder, chute and does-not-exist all fall out of cost, so no legend can exist. Walking skeleton runs end to end.
rounds.proof: One drawn line, four readings: DOES NOT EXIST to CAR, PLAIN to RAIN, LADDER to WHEELCHAIR, a shortcut to FOOT.

shots.cap: v0 — downtown Atlanta, the Connector, CAR's ground brought forward

gaps: 25 fps with an empty cloth — cloth.js walks all 20,585 edges every frame
the two ink passes turn to mud; the operative topology is not clearly brought forward
becoming is a white flash with a line of text
nothing has accumulated yet — the used world does not out-read the planned world
